Triage: `needs-user-decision`, type Feature. Which text keys are expression-bindable is a contract question — the card's three directions each change the accepted authoring surface (per the #3972/#3987 family precedent, human floor).

Four prisms:
1. **Platform long-term coherence** — direction 1 (a declared text-key evaluation set) closes the evaluate/read-back split with one declared vocabulary; direction 2 (merge `props` into the node) re-legalizes the envelope shape #4786's teaching rewrite just retired — incoherent.
2. **Measured business pull** — `statistic` is the dashboard workhorse and today has NO way to bind a dynamic value; the former teaching-face workaround renders blank. Real authoring pull.
3. **AI-agent error-resistance** — today's state is the worst shape: an AI following the docs renders literals or blanks silently. Direction 3 (publish-time diagnostic on an unevaluated `${…}` reaching the DOM) is the loud-refusal floor even if 1 is deferred.
4. **Startup scope discipline** — direction 1 is a permanent vocabulary obligation; direction 3 is cheap and reversible.

Recommendation: 3 now (loud refusal); 1 only with an explicitly declared, closed key set in spec/types; never 2. **Joint axis with #4797** (same SchemaRenderer evaluation contract) — recommend ruling both in one sitting.

**Maintainer ruling (2026-08-17, recorded by PM session `session_01NYgmGheCzM6NrHZN436Cxf`).** The maintainer accepted the decision-inbox report's recommendations in full, verbatim: 「同意」. Ruled together with #4797 (same SchemaRenderer evaluation contract):

**Ruled: Direction 3 now; Direction 1 deferred with a named restart condition; ⛔ Direction 2 never.**
1. **Now (dispatchable)**: a publish/render-time loud diagnostic when an unevaluated `${…}` expression reaches the DOM — the silent-literal/silent-blank shape becomes a named refusal pointing at the working channels (`content`, or host pre-resolution).
2. **Deferred — Direction 1** (a declared, closed set of expression-bindable text keys — `title`/`label`/`value`/`description` — evaluated by the memo): reopens as a **spec-first design card** when the named restart condition fires — *the first real schema-authored dashboard need hits the gap* (e.g. an AI-authoring flow that must bind `statistic.value` and cannot pre-resolve). Until then hosts pre-resolve, which is how every shipped dashboard works today. If reopened: the key set is declared in `@objectstack/spec`/types as a closed enum, never inferred — and the accept-surface change is fable-tier.
3. ⛔ **Direction 2 (merge `props` into the node) is permanently rejected** — it re-legalizes the envelope shape the #4786 teaching rewrite just retired.

Label flipped `needs-user-decision` → `pm:queue` (the Direction-3 work) in the same stroke; when it lands, this card records the Direction-1 restart condition and closes or holds per the seat's judgement.

## 前提复测:卡面表格两行仍成立,标题那句话已被 #5122 推翻

新基线上逐行实测(真 renderer,`dataSource: { total: 99, n: 99 }`):

- 顶层 `value` / `title` / `label` ⇒ 字面量 `${…}` 上屏 —— **仍成立**(`ui:card` 那行还额外落成 DOM 属性 `title="${data.total}"`)。
- `props` 信封 ⇒ 求值出 99 但读不回,渲染成**空白** —— **仍成立**。
- 成因判断(memo 只处理 `content` / `props.*` / 现加 `properties.*` / 谓词键)—— **复核通过**。

但卡面标题「**除 `content` 外没有任何文本键既被求值又被读回**」在含 #5122 的基线上**已不再成立**:写成 `properties` 信封时,`value` / `title` / `label` 三个键**都**既被求值又被读回(实测均渲染出 `99`)。机制是 #5122 让 `properties.*` 参与求值,而**既有的 hoist** 又把求值后的值抄到节点顶层 —— 正好是 `StatisticRenderer` 读 `schema.value`、`CardTitle` 读 `schema.title` 的位置。这不是本 PR 造成的,是 #5122 落地后的既成事实,在此记录以免下一位读者按旧表格外推。

**⚠️ 留给维护者一裁**:诊断文案里我**没有**写 `properties`。裁定原文把可用通道列为「`content`, or host pre-resolution」,而「`properties` 信封算不算 `ui:*` 的正式创作面」是契约/教学面判断(#4786 刚把 `props` 信封那个 workaround 从教学面撤掉),不该由我在一条诊断消息里替仓库定下来。文案是否加上 `properties`,请裁。

## 射程边界(如实记录)

诊断只认「**未求值的 `${…}` 到达 DOM**」,所以 `props` 信封那一类(求值了但读不回 → 空白)**不响,也按定义响不了** —— 那里到达 DOM 的是 `99`,只是落错了地方。卡面的这一半随方向 1 / 契约裁量走,不在本 PR 内。

**publish-time 半边不做**:侦查后自然挂点落在 CLI 校验器文件,#5115 席在飞,按不撞文件纪律留后续。

## 方向 1 的重启条件(本卡继续承载)

裁定评论 5312061331 第 2 条:*第一个真实的 schema 编排仪表盘需求撞上这个缺口*(例如一个必须绑定 `statistic.value` 且无法宿主预解析的 AI 编排流程)。本 PR **未预告、未实现**方向 1,措辞也未暗示。方向 2 未触碰。

按裁定「落地后本卡记录重启条件并**由席位判断关卡与否**」—— 我的判断是**先不关**:PR 尚在 draft 且未合,而卡面此刻的主要价值已从「方向 3 待做」转为「方向 1 重启条件的存放处」+ 上面那条 `properties` 待裁。**建议 PM 验收合并后再定**:或改标题/正文收敛为方向 1 的重启卡,或关卡另开一张重启卡承载。

## Ruling: item 2 scope = the carriage map, two sub-rules fixed, location = `objectui check`, sequenced after #7015 (maintainer 2026-08-31)

Director seat · session `session_01KGtaLpkW1mycWgkbSb3H6t` · decision batch #20 ②

Maintainer verbatim (batch reply): 「其他同意」 — adopting the presented recommendation in full. The deferral premise this card has been parked on has FIRED: objectstack#13670 was ruled (batch #17) as **option 2** — `content` is the sole evaluation channel for `text`, NO `value` row is added, and the 23 documented `text.value` examples move to `content` via **#7015** (already `pm:queue`).

### Ruled content

1. **Item 2 (build-time loud rejection) scope = the carriage map.** Reject `${...}` appearing in any of the four closed keys (`title` / `label` / `value` / `description`) on a component node whose `expressionBindableTextKeysFor(type)` answer excludes that key — **no-row types included**: `text.value` and `action:button.label` are rejected, because the empty set is the contract's answer (ruled machine-answerable on objectstack#13672, 2026-08-31), and a loud build-time refusal beats a silent literal reaching users. A row can always be added later with a named need + its own measurement.
2. **Sub-rule (i)**: the gate walks **component nodes only**. The page document root's own `title` is a page key, not a component text key — out of scope by construction (this is the census's `type: page` catch).
3. **Sub-rule (ii)**: a type string that resolves to **no registered component** (e.g. `stat-card`) gets a **warning, not a rejection** — the open string arm is deliberate (a custom renderer may legitimately self-evaluate), there is zero measured pull to police it, reopen free.
4. **Sub-question ③ ruled**: item 2 lives in **`objectui check`** (`packages/cli/src/commands/check.ts`) — the natural hook; the file-contention that originally parked ③ has lifted (no open PR touches `packages/cli`).
5. ⛔ **Sequencing gate**: dispatch item 2 only **after #7015 lands** — the 23 documented `text.value` examples move to `content` first, so the gate does not go red on the platform's own guide on day one.

### State (same stroke)

`needs-user-decision` → `pm:queue` carrying the sequencing gate above; `domain:ui` stays. Unchanged by this ruling: **PR #6981** (item 1, contract review PASSed) remains **draft awaiting human merge** (governed surface — os-zhuang / hotlong); the card still holds Direction 1's restart record and closes only when item 2 ships.

### Why it was on the list, and why the list was wrong

This card was carried across handovers as *"#4795 — stale `os-sam` assignee, same class as #7206 / #7190 / #7175 / #6771"*. Those four **were** residue: an assignee with no claim comment behind it. ⛔ This one is not, and the difference is visible only by reading the thread.

**Evidence, from the card's own 18 comments:**

| | |
|:--|:--|
| a real claim | `os-sam`, 2026-08-31 — *"Claim: PM loop — `domain:ui` execution seat"* |
| work actually done | two `os-dev-report` comments, same day |
| item 1 shipped | *"ruling item 1 shipped; item 2 needs a maintainer call. Card stays OPEN."* |
| reviewed at tier | a director-seat contract-review record (`session_015adLit3ZYASJiXwxKG78Wi`) |
| item 2 ruled | 2026-08-31, scope fixed to the carriage map, sequenced |
| currently blocked | 2026-09-01 — `Blocked-by: objectstack-ai/objectstack#13670` |

⇒ The assignee records a **completed, reported, partially-shipped claim** by a predecessor session of **this same seat**, and the card is now legitimately `pm:blocked` on an upstream. Stripping the assignee would have erased the provenance of shipped work and made the four genuine repairs look like five.

### The branch probe, and why its zero was not the answer

`git ls-remote origin 'refs/heads/*4795*'` returns **nothing**, with three controls firing (`refs/heads/main` = 1, `refs/heads/claude/issue-*` = **68**, a known-live issue branch = 1). So the zero is a reading.

⚠️ **But "no branch" was the wrong question here.** The branch is gone because the work **landed** — PR #5129 (direction 3, render-time half) and PR #6981, the latter merged 07:45Z on 2026-08-31 per the correction comment on this card. An absent branch is equally consistent with a dead claim and a finished one, and only the thread distinguishes them. ⇒ The probe that repaired #7206/#7190/#7175/#6771 does not generalise to a card that has shipped.

### Disposition

⛔ Nothing to do. `pm:blocked` + `Blocked-by: objectstack-ai/objectstack#13670` is honest state; the existing unlock scan owns the wake-up. The assignee stays. **This item is closed out of the seat's owed list** — it was never an error.
